newsitem.title: UK: Tanzania's Dar es Salaam to resume oil handling.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania's Dar es Salaam to resume oil handling.

text.p: The Tanzanian port of Dar es Salaam is to resume handling oil tankers, after being unable to do so for several months because its offshore pumping plant was out of operation, Lloyds casualty reporting service said.
Dar es Salaam harbour is too shallow for large tankers, forcing them to unload cargoes at a floating platform, which has been inoperative since August after developing leaks.
One tanker bearing a cargo of 85,000 tonnes of crude destined for Zambia has been waiting to discharge for the last two months.
Port officials said three tankers were waiting to offload 250,000 tonnes of crude over the next few days. -- Colin Wooster, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7456
